newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: DCC says now owns 100 pct of Printech Group.
newsitem.headline: DCC says now owns 100 pct of Printech Group.

text.p: Irish industrial holding company DCC Plc said on Wednesday that it now owns 100 percent of Printech group following the purchase of the outstanding 12.7 percent of the share capital held by Brian Stokes.
The purchase consideration for the 12.7 percent stake was paid by issuing 486,007 new ordinary shares in DCC to Stokes.
At a DCC share price of three Irish pounds, the value of the consideration amounted to 1.458 million punts, DCC said in a statement.
In addition, Ochil, the holding group for Printech, has redeemed 1.456 million of related loan notes.
Stokes was the founder and non-executive deputy chairman of Printech. He will remain on the board of Ochil and of Printech as a non-executive director.

Printech Group provides manufacturing services to multinational computer hardware and software companies. It has manufacturing facilities in Ireland and Scotland and sales support locations in France, Spain, North America and Asia.
